svg.title: AREA 28
svg.desc: Clear turrets on both sides of warp 1 before everyone enters the maze room. One enters at the lower-left; three operate outside pads. There are nine barriers including entry; call each cleared barrier. Identify outer pads by this layout. Release entry first, then relay through the numbered 1→8 instructions; wait for the runner’s call. Activate the center switch before warp 2; missing it forces the party to repeat the maze. Sakura places 2’s landing near the entrance, facing the opened door. All take 3, then turn left to advance; straight goes backward. Hidden boxes are optional: Sakura calls boxes trap-free, but Palace warns of technique turrets on access. Sources differ; omit this detour.
